t: Swarfega heavy duty hand cleaner provides effective cleaning for trade professionals. Ideal for mechanics, builders, and plumbers, this hand cleaner tackles tough workshop grime. Its powerful formula, featuring non-abrasive cornmeal scrubbing agents, efficiently removes ingrained oil, grease, and general dirt. The added skin moisturiser and refreshing orange fragrance ensure hands are left clean, fresh, and conditioned after use. Being solvent-free and dermatologically tested, it offers a safe and thorough cleaning solution for busy work environments.
